value.rationale: The natural Čech object accommodates all simple graphs, and its complete integral automorphism module and edge-inclusion persistent homology are determined functorially, not simply counted. The signed involution action distinguishes endpoint reversals, and explicit primitive four-vertex cycles allow filtered class tracking with zero deaths. This is a meaningful general invariant and geometric cycle basis motivated by graph-indexed Boolean data, rather than a restatement of the complete-edge Betti formula.
